name: T. W. Ives
bio: T. W. Ives was the telegraph operator at Sentinel Butte, who came to Medora for the Thanksgiving ball in November 1884. In early 1885 Dan Williams was appointed agent at Sentinel Butte and briefly took his place, but in April 1885 the paper reported Ives still 'shooting lightning' there.

moments.label: Came to Medora for the Thanksgiving ball
Still operating the telegraph at Sentinel Butte

mentions: …place has been taken by L. W. Anderson. Ives is in Sentinel Butte, and S. P. Elverson has his place as night operator, and Mr. Maxwell, formerly in the car accountant's office in Mandan, exchanges places to-day with agent Fegan.
Operator Ives, of Sentinel Butte, came up last evening to attend the Thanksgiving ball.

The pleasantest dance that has ever been held in Medora took place last evening in Roberts & Co.'s hall. There was an unusually large attendance, and nothing occurred to mar the pleasure of the occasion.
…o hear that Dan Williams has received the appointment of agent at Sentinel Butte. We have not yet heard where Ives will go.
Dan Williams came down from Sentinel Bute where he went to take operator Ive's place for a few days.
T. W. Ives is still shooting lightning at Sentinel Butte.
